∀ (k G : Type u) [inst : Field.{u} k] [IsAlgClosed.{u} k] [inst_2 : Group.{u} G] [inst_3 : Fintype.{u} G]
  [NeZero.{u} (Nat.cast.{u} (Nat.card.{u} G))],
  Exists.{1} fun n =>
    Exists.{u + 2} fun V =>
      Exists.{1} fun d =>
        Exists.{u + 1} fun ρ_dec =>
          And (∀ (i : Fin n), CategoryTheory.Simple.{u, u + 1} (V i))
            (And (∀ (i j : Fin n), Nonempty.{u + 1} (CategoryTheory.Iso.{u, u + 1} (V i) (V j)) → Eq.{1} i j)
              (And
                (∀ (W : FDRep.{u, u} k G),
                  CategoryTheory.Simple.{u, u + 1} W →
                    Exists.{1} fun i => Nonempty.{u + 1} (CategoryTheory.Iso.{u, u + 1} W (V i)))
                (And
                  (∀ (i : Fin n),
                    Eq.{1} (d i) (Module.finrank.{u, u} k (FGModuleCat.carrier.{u, u} (Action.V.{u, u + 1, u} (V i)))))
                  (And
                    (∀ (g : G) (w : (i : Fin n) → Fin (d i) → FGModuleCat.carrier.{u, u} (Action.V.{u, u + 1, u} (V i)))
                      (i : Fin n) (j : Fin (d i)),
                      Eq.{u + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} ρ_dec g) w i j)
                        (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
                          (DFunLike.coe.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (FDRep.ρ.{u, u} (V i)) g) (w i j)))
                    (Nonempty.{u + 1}
                      (CategoryTheory.Iso.{u, u + 1} (MonoidAlgebra.regularFDRep.{u} k G) (FDRep.of.{u, u} ρ_dec)))))))

{k G : Type u} →
  [inst : Field.{u} k] →
    [inst_1 : IsAlgClosed.{u} k] →
      [inst_2 : Group.{u} G] →
        [inst_3 : Fintype.{u} G] →
          [inst_4 : NeZero.{u} (Nat.cast.{u} (Nat.card.{u} G))] →
            (D : IrrepDecomp.{u, u} k G) →
              CategoryTheory.Iso.{u, u + 1} (MonoidAlgebra.regularFDRep.{u} k G) (IrrepDecomp.columnMultFDRep.{u} D)
